paite: Unaute aw, khamite kiang a gen bang in na kiang uah thu ka gen thei kei hi; sa mite, Khrist a naungekte kiang a gen bang in ka gen zaw hi.
heading: Saptuam Sung A Kipawlkhenna
english: Brothers, I couldn’t speak to you as to spiritual, but as to fleshly, as to babies in Christ.

paite: An gum na nek theih nai louh ziak un, nawitui in ka hon vak a, sami na hih lai ziak un tua an gum tu tanpha in leng na ne thei nai kei lailai uhi.
english: I fed you with milk, not with solid food, for you weren’t yet ready. Indeed, you aren’t ready even now,

paite: Na lak ua kihazatna leh kiselna a-om nak ziak in sami hi lai in mihing bang a om lai hilou na hi uhiam?
english: for you are still fleshly. For insofar as there is jealousy, strife, and factions among you, aren’t you fleshly, and don’t you walk in the ways of men?

paite: Mi khat in, “Paul pawl ka hi," midang in, “Kei zaw Apollos pawl ka hi," na chih lai teng uh mihing lel hi lai hilou na hi uhiam?
english: For when one says, “I follow Paul,” and another, “I follow Apollos,” aren’t you fleshly?

paite: Apollos kua ahia le? Paul leng kua ahia? Nasemmi, noumau hon gingtasak mi lel ahi ve ua, huai leng Toupa'n apiak bang zel in ahi.
english: Who then is Apollos, and who is Paul, but servants through whom you believed, and each as the Lord gave to him?

paite: Ke'n ka suan a, Apollos in tui in avak a, himahleh Pathian in akhangsak hi.
english: I planted. Apollos watered. But God gave the increase.

paite: Huchi in akhangsakpa Pathian kia lou ngal, asuanpa lah bangmah ahi kei a, tui a vakpa leng bangmah ahi tuan kei hi.
english: So then neither he who plants is anything, nor he who waters, but God who gives the increase.

paite: Huan asuanpa leh tui a vakpa pum khat ahi ua, himahleh amau sepgim bang zel in, amau kipahman amu tuaktuak ding uhi.
english: Now he who plants and he who waters are the same, but each will receive his own reward according to his own labor.

paite: Koute Pathian na seppihte ka hi ua, noute Pathian louma na hi ua, Pathian inn lam leng na hi uhi.
english: For we are God’s fellow workers. You are God’s farming, God’s building.

paite: Pathian in hehpihna hon piak bang zel in inn lam heutupen piltak bang in ke'n suangphum ka lem a, midang in atung ah inn alam uhi. Himahleh michih atung a alamdan ding uah pilvang uhen.
heading: Michih Nasep Ettelna
english: According to the grace of God which was given to me, as a wise master builder I laid a foundation, and another builds on it. But let each man be careful how he builds on it.

paite: Suangphum lepkhitsa lou ngal suangphum dang kuamah in alem theita kei ua, huai suangphum Jesu Khrist ahi.
english: For no one can lay any other foundation than that which has been laid, which is Jesus Christ.

paite: Hiai suangphum tung ah kuapeuh in dangka-eng in hiam, dangka in hiam, suangmantam in hiam, sing in hiam, loupa in hiam, buhpawl hiam zang in lam taleh;
english: But if anyone builds on the foundation with gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay, or straw,

paite: michih nasep ahong lang ding hi; tua Ni in hihlang ding ahi ngal a, meikuang a akilak ding ziak in; meikuang ngeingei in michih nasep bangchibang ahia chih a-enchian ding hi.
english: each man’s work will be revealed. For the Day will declare it, because it is revealed in fire; and the fire itself will test what sort of work each man’s work is.

paite: Kua nasep leng atung a alam pen a-om gigeleh huai mi in kipahman amu ding.
english: If any man’s work remains which he built on it, he will receive a reward.

paite: Kua nasep leng akatleh huai mi in atan ding hi; amah taktak zaw hotdam in a-om ding, himahleh mei apaisuak bang in.
english: If any man’s work is burned, he will suffer loss, but he himself will be saved, but as through fire.

paite: Pathian tempul na hih uleh Pathian Kha noumau sung ah ateng gige chih na thei kei ua hia?
english: Don’t you know that you are God’s temple and that God’s Spirit lives in you?

paite: Kuapeuh in Pathian tempul ahihsiatleh Pathian in huai mi ahihse ding; Pathian tempul asiangthou ngal a, huai tempul noumau na hi uhi.
english: If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him; for God’s temple is holy, which you are.

paite: Kuamah amah-le-amah kikhem kei hen. Na lak ua kuapeuh hiai khovel a pil akisakleh, ahong piltheihna ding in mihai hong suak hen.
english: Let no one deceive himself. If anyone thinks that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool that he may become wise.

paite: Hiai khovel pilna Pathian ngaihdan in haina ahi. "Ama'n amaute apil lepchiahna uah aman hi," chih gelh ahi;
english: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, “He has taken the wise in their craftiness.”

paite: Toupa'n mipilte ngaihtuahna athawn ahi, chih athei chi a gelh ahi nawn lai hi.
english: And again, “The Lord knows the reasoning of the wise, that it is worthless.”

paite: Huaiziak in kuamah in mihingte suang kei hen; bangkim nou a ahi vekta ngal a;
english: Therefore let no one boast in men. For all things are yours,

paite: Paul hiam, Apollos hiam, Kifas hiam, khovel hiam, hinna hiam, sihna hiam, thil omsa hiam, thil hong om ding hiam;
english: whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come. All are yours,

paite: avek in nou a ahi vek hi; noumau leng Khrist a na hi ua; Khrist leng Pathian a ahi.
english: and you are Christ’s, and Christ is God’s.
